name: Pay in lieu of notice (สินจ้างแทนการบอกกล่าวล่วงหน้า s.17/1)
authority: Labour Protection Act s.17 para.2 (No.2 B.E.2551) and s.17/1 (No.7 B.E.2562), Council of State consolidation through No.9 B.E.2568, https://searchlaw.ocs.go.th/council-of-state/#/public/doc/ZGN3NXk0eENvNjBSdjRnT2NsdjFTQT09 (register TH-EXIT-04): an employer ending an indefinite contract gives notice at or before a payday, effective on the next payday; without it the employer pays the wages from the removal to the day notice would have taken effect, on the day the employee leaves. Priced from the notice date (exit fact `notice_given_on`; unrecorded is no notice) through the payday after the first payday on or after it, monthly wage over each calendar month's days (`payday_notice_days`, `notice_monthly_wages`). Tax: a one-time payment on leaving (DG Notification on income tax No.45 cl.1(ง), https://www.rd.go.th/3213.html) withheld with severance under scheme SEVERANCE_TAX (Revenue Code s.50(1) para.3, s.48(5)); outside Order P.96/2543's regular method (PIT), the Social Security Act s.5 wage (not pay for work) and the Employee Welfare Fund wage.
